item.title: Master Career Pivots Without Starting Over 🌟 • Use: “I leveraged my skills in X to excel in Y.” • Identify transferable skills that apply to the new field. • Showcase how past experiences are relevant to the pivot. • Network with professionals in the target industry. • Focus on continuous learning and relevant certifications. 📚 What existing skills can you highlight to support your career pivot? #career #transitions #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
